tweets: Meenakshi Amman Temple, Madurai — 14 gopurams ring the shrine, the tallest nearly 52 metres. Every tier is packed with stucco gods, sages and dancers — some 33,000 figures in all, repainted roughly once a decade to keep the colour alive.
